zh: 所有询问都从同一个 source 出发，边权非负，跑一次单源最短路就能回答全部目标。
用 Dijkstra：小根堆按当前距离出队，出队时若记录已过期就跳过，否则松弛所有出边。
建有向邻接表（节点转成 0-based）；距离初始化为无穷、source 为 0；堆上 Dijkstra 结束后，按询问顺序输出 dist，仍为无穷的输出 −1。距离可达 2×10¹⁴，用 64 位整数。
en: All queries start from the same source and edge weights are non-negative, so a single single-source shortest-path run answers every target.
Use Dijkstra: pop from a min-heap by current distance, skip the entry if it is stale, and otherwise relax all outgoing edges.

Build a directed adjacency list (convert nodes to 0-based); initialize distances to infinity and the source to 0; after the heap-based Dijkstra, print dist for the targets in query order, with −1 for those still at infinity. Distances reach 2×10¹⁴, so use 64-bit integers.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Run Dijkstra from source and answer each query with its distance.

## Proof of correctness

Non-negative weights guarantee that a distance popped by Dijkstra can no longer be improved; relaxation covers every reachable path, and a node still at infinity is unreachable.

## Complexity

O((n+m) log n) time, O(n+m) space.
